contract.name: BookCatalog
contract.description: Contract for accessing the logical structure of the educational book.

capability.name: BookCatalog
capability.responsibility: Provide the logical structure and content references of the book.

output.description: Stable narration identifier associated with the page.

rules: BookCatalog owns the logical structure of the book.
Pages are returned in logical reading order.
Each interior page may reference one narration identifier.
The cover does not require a narration identifier.
Narration provider information is not owned by BookCatalog.
BookCatalog does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
BookCatalog exposes WHAT is available, not HOW resources are implemented.

errors.BOOK_NOT_FOUND: The requested book does not exist.
errors.PAGE_NOT_FOUND: The requested page does not exist.
errors.NARRATION_NOT_ASSIGNED: The requested page has no narration identifier.
